ts.description: Timestamp of the message, e.g. 1710304378.475129. Required (with Channel) when targeting a message.

file.label: File ID
file.description: File ID to get reactions for (e.g. F0123ABCD). Provide this instead of Channel and Message Timestamp when targeting a file.

full.label: Full Reaction List
full.description: If enabled, returns the complete list of reactions (not truncated).

channel.label: Channel

slack_list_channels.label: List Channels

types.label: Types
types.description: Comma-separated conversation types to include. One or more of 'public_channel', 'private_channel', 'mpim', 'im'. Defaults to public and private channels.

excludeArchived.label: Exclude Archived
excludeArchived.description: Omit archived channels from the results.

slack_list_custom_emoji.label: List Custom Emoji
slack_list_custom_emoji.description: List the custom emoji of the workspace.

slack_list_files.label: List Files
slack_list_files.description: List files in the workspace, optionally filtered by channel, user, or type.

channel.label: Channel
channel.description: Only return files shared in this channel (e.g. C0123ABCD). Pass a channel ID, or resolve a #name first with Find Channel. Leave empty for all channels.

user.label: User
user.description: Only return files uploaded by this user ID (e.g. U0123ABCD). Leave empty for all users.

types.label: File Types
types.description: Comma-separated file types to filter by. One or more of: 'all', 'spaces', 'snippets', 'images', 'gdocs', 'zips', 'pdfs'. Defaults to 'all'.

tsFrom.label: Created After
tsFrom.description: Only return files created at or after this Unix timestamp in seconds (e.g. 1710304378).

tsTo.label: Created Before
tsTo.description: Only return files created at or before this Unix timestamp in seconds (e.g. 1710304378).

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of files to return per page (1-1000). Defaults to 100.

slack_list_files.afterResponse:
if (!response.ok) throw new Error('An API error occurred: ' + response.error);
return {files: response.files ?? [], count: response.files?.length ?? 0, paging: response.paging};

slack_list_user_conversations.label: List User Conversations
slack_list_user_conversations.description: Lists the channels a user belongs to.

types.description: Comma-separated conversation types to include. One or more of 'public_channel', 'private_channel', 'mpim', 'im'. Defaults to public and private channels.

excludeArchived.label: Exclude Archived
excludeArchived.description: Omit archived channels from the results.

user.description: Show reactions made by this user ID (e.g. U0123ABCD). Leave empty to use the authenticated user.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (1-1000). Defaults to 100.

slack_remove_reaction.label: Remove Reaction
slack_remove_reaction.description: Remove an emoji reaction from a message or file.

reaction.label: Emoji
reaction.description: The emoji name without colons, e.g. thumbsup.

channel.label: Channel
channel.description: Channel ID of the message to remove the reaction from (e.g. C0123ABCD). Required when targeting a message; leave empty when targeting a file.

ts.label: Message Timestamp
ts.description: Timestamp of the message to remove the reaction from, e.g. 1710304378.475129. Required (with Channel) when targeting a message.

file.label: File ID
file.description: File ID to remove the reaction from (e.g. F0123ABCD). Provide this instead of Channel and Message Timestamp when targeting a file.

user.label: User
user.description: Slack user ID to remove, e.g. 'U0123456789'. Resolve a handle/email to an ID first with Find User by Handle / Find User by Email.

slack_rename_channel.label: Rename Channel

channel.description: Channel ID (e.g. 'C0123456789'). Pass a channel ID, or resolve a #name to an ID first with Find Channel.

slack_set_channel_purpose.description: Sets the purpose on a channel.

channel.label: Channel
channel.description: Channel ID (e.g. 'C0123456789'). Pass a channel ID, or resolve a #name to an ID first with Find Channel.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.description: The new purpose text. Pass an empty string to clear the purpose.
